mapper.sql: id, org_id, org_name, role_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select x.org_id from sys_internal_role_org x inner join sys_internal_role sir on x.role_id = sir.id inner join sys_internal_role_user siru on sir.id = siru.role_id inner join sys_internal_user siu on siru.sys_user_id = siu.id where 1 = 1 and x.del_flag = '0' and sir.del_flag = '0' and siru.del_flag ='0' and siu.del_flag ='0' and siu.user_code = #{userCode}
